publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Sabino

record.title: A mapping can exist and still fault
record.method: Descriptor walk and isolated control of translation interpretation
record.observation: The commpage address translated into backed RAM, but the A53 access-flag interpretation rejected the legacy descriptor. A control retaining the same descriptors permitted the read and ran for 40.12 seconds without the measured synchronous fault.
record.limits: This control establishes one mapping interpretation on the model, not complete VM correctness or a physical memory test.

records.access: Private project record; original material is not distributed

exhibits.title: The address was backed; the access still faulted
rows: Level-2 access-flag fault in this mode
exhibits.interpretation: The translation lands inside RAM. The failure concerns descriptor interpretation, so adding RAM at the virtual address would address the wrong problem.

exhibits.title: Observed control result
exhibits.interpretation: The control isolates one interpretation of the existing descriptors. It is not a complete VM or hardware validation.
